title: MAPPA to Reveal Chainsaw Man Update and New Projects During 15th Anniversary Presentation
content: Animation studio MAPPA has announced a special 15th anniversary lineup presentation, set to stream on its official YouTube channel on June 19. The event will feature updates on several of the studio’s major projects, alongside the reveal of entirely new ones.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Jujutsu Kaisen’s Latest Film
content: The highly anticipated Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 has yet to share any details on its release date. The anime will continue to adapt the intense Culling Game Arc, where the Jujutsu sorcerers are forced to participate in a deathly battle royale.

title: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration Anime Reveals Trailer, Visual, July 4 Premiere
content: The previously announced The Duke’s Son Claims He Won’t Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration anime revealed a new trailer and visual on Wednesday, featuring a July 4 premiere date. The theme song artists were also revealed and their songs are previewed in the latest trailer. Riria.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Unveils Fourth Story Visual Starring Coco and Tartah
content: Witch Hat Atelier anime unveiled its fourth story visual on Friday, mainly featuring Coco and Tartah. The series is currently ongoing, with 10 episodes released and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Netflix.

title: Multimedia Project 'Heavily Armed High School Girls' Gets TV Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Good Smile Company announced a television anime adaptation of illustrator neco's Juu Heisougata Joshikousei ( Heavily Armed High School Girls ) multimedia franchise on Friday, revealing the main staff, a brand new visual (pictured), and the teaser promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Game Streams Walkthrough Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a walkthrough trailer on Thursday for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve , the newest game in its Ace Combat modern air combat franchise . The game will launch on October 2 for the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN
